title: UneceTradeProductCertification
description:
The process of certifying that a certain product has passed performance and quality assurance tests, or qualification
requirements stipulated in regulations.

applicableStandard.description: A referenced standard applicable to this trade product certification.

assertion.description: An assertion, expressed as text, for this trade product certification, such as that this product is free from peanuts.

assertionCode.description: A code specifying an assertion for this trade product certification, such as claims that a product is free from peanuts.

relatedLocation.description: A referenced location related to this trade product certification.

responsibleAgency.description: The agency, expressed as text, responsible for this trade product certification.

specifiedAssertion.description: A sustainability assertion specified for this trade product certification.

standard.description: The standard, expressed as text, for this trade product certification.
